symptom: After the root-scope/action transaction was hardened, the current Agent still repeatedly over-weighted the latest framing: it first treated the size of a Skill catalog as the main limitation, then rapidly treated the user's occupation example as the new root explanation. It also used the external Skill catalog primarily to search already-known methods instead of first learning how the source itself organizes capabilities and can expose unknown needs.
user_impact: The user must repeatedly supply the missing abstraction, challenge the Agent's current framing, and point out discovery methods the Agent should have inferred independently. This weakens confidence that UAOS can discover latent requirements or hold competing frames long enough to falsify them before changing the system.
micro_diagnosis: config/DOMAIN_HEALTH_ESCALATION_POLICY.json required each external Skill candidate to map to a concrete need/failure class/capability gap, which structurally favored already-known needs.

src/uaos/kernel/domain_health.py required mapped_need_or_failure_class to be non-empty, so an outside-in discovered capability gap could not enter the governed candidate path without pretending the need was known first.

The cognition stage sequence was separately represented in DELIBERATION_POLICY, SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY, COMMON_BEHAVIOR_ASSURANCE, ENTRYPOINT and AGENTS, increasing hot-path cognitive surface and drift risk even though executable gates were concentrated in deliberation.py/problem_closure.py.
Existing root-scope logic protects action after a problem is framed, but it does not by itself teach broad source-first capability discovery before a useful need has been named.

competing_hypotheses.evidence: A multi-million-item catalog does not imply item-by-item study; SkillsMP exposes occupation, category, creator, repository, task and keyword axes that compress the search space.

Occupation/role analysis is useful but cannot alone find workflow handoff, taxonomy, creator-portfolio, repository-portfolio or adjacent-domain gaps. Literal role-to-Agent mapping would repeat the user-example-to-architecture failure.
The current external Skill intake API mechanically required a pre-existing mapped need/failure class and had no admission for source-first multi-lens discovery of latent gaps.

The same cognition sequence and anti-anchoring semantics were repeated across multiple hot/near-hot authority surfaces, while the executable behavior was owned by a much smaller set of kernel gates. This increases comprehension and drift cost without adding independent enforcement.

Host-level complete mediation would be a stronger assurance tier and is not currently available/required for baseline operation. The repair instead reduces the cognitive hot path and strengthens executable admissions while preserving the existing assurance boundary.

external_method_evidence.finding: The catalog supports task, creator, repository, category, occupation and keyword navigation rather than one flat item list; occupation browsing exposes 23 major groups and 867 SOC occupations.
external_method_evidence.borrow: Treat catalog organization axes as discovery affordances before choosing queries.
external_method_evidence.reject: Treat catalog classification as quality certification or literal system architecture.

external_method_evidence.finding: Occupational knowledge is decomposed into worker requirements, work activities, work context and occupation-specific tasks across multiple granularities.
external_method_evidence.borrow: Use role/task/activity structure as one outside-in lens for capability discovery.
external_method_evidence.reject: Assume organizational job titles directly define Agent boundaries.

external_method_evidence.finding: Value-stream analysis follows end-to-end material/information flow and deliberately looks at the whole rather than optimizing isolated process steps.
external_method_evidence.borrow: Use workflow/handoff analysis as a separate lens for discovering unowned or broken interfaces.
external_method_evidence.reject: Require a full VSM ritual for every narrow lookup or local defect.
